runnerInputs: Accepts the pinned pre-slice installed package or the recorded authored package. Copies it into a disposable directory, applies the slice only to the pre-slice tree, checks every authored file, and launches isolated native processes. An optional first argument selects one exact named check.
note: This slice is not an installer patch. The complete installer patch is regenerated against the published 18.1.10 archive, whose SHA512 matched the frozen lock. Composition002 installation evidence remains historical; correction-specific installation and runtime receipts identify the corrected tree separately.

exports.createCooperativeOriginal: ({ownershipDirectory,cwd,sessionDirectory}) => Promise<{manager,binding}>; enrollment before the first original header, never retrospective
exports.openAdmittedOriginal: ({ownershipDirectory,binding,source,commandId}) => Promise<SessionManager>; actual writer-process lease before writable load

ownershipDirectoryArgument.requirement: All participants pass the identical canonical absolute spelling. Native applies path.resolve, not realpath. Inspection never creates this directory. Enrollers also use a canonical sessionDirectory; original-file aliases are refused.

ownershipDirectoryLayout.leases/<registryId>.lock: stable FileLock key; kernel-named on Linux/Windows, physical flock sidecar on other Unix platforms; physical sidecars are never unlinked

transcriptSidecar: <sessionDir>/.<basename>.original-enrollment.json - durable enrolled-source marker; restricts only, never grants
changes: Native enrollment and ownership helpers, guarded native SessionManager writes and identity transitions, high-level AgentSession pre-effect guards, and orphan-backup recovery refusal for marked originals.
Worker protocol 73 open-original mode with classified refusal/unknown outcomes and exact live admitted-handle checks.
Durable host admission service with captured preparation, command coalescing and reconciliation, exact retained binding, historical receipts that never reopen, and joined disposal.
Imported workers cannot enable browser recovery or detach through preserveReconnect; Root drains public actions, then native admission, then the general runtime.
supportedRegime: Conditional known-cooperating SDK writers only. Free locks, quiet files, PID absence or markers alone never establish participation. The bundled stock CLI is not automatically enrolled or rebuilt by these source-module changes.
supportedIdentityOperations: Explicit admitted open/resume of the same original native ID, canonical file and recorded/canonical cwd. Unsupported new/fork/switch/move/revive-elsewhere/branch identity transitions refuse before effects and remain backlog, not waived requirements.
leaseLifetime: Seal and successful terminal native drain are required before release. Seal alone does not release; failed drain retains ownership until proven cleanup or process death.
leaseBackend: Pinned pi-natives 18.1.10 selects Linux/Windows kernel-name ownership without requiring or fabricating a filesystem sidecar. Other Unix platforms require the acquired sidecar inode and check it before every write, including an already-open append writer. Actual native acquired state remains mandatory on all platforms; original parent/file identity guards and terminal-drain release semantics are unchanged.
hostServiceLifecycle: Cold reopen uses prepare({binding}) then admit with a fresh explicit command. getRetainedHandle is lookup-only. An admitted receipt is historical, not live ownership. Superseded non-current admitted handles are pruned only after a new writer owns the identical binding; failed-cleanup handles remain retained.

validation.historicalComposition002: The following native18, worker9, direct-service, typecheck and build results belong to the immutable pre-correction macOS composition002, not to the corrected tree.
validation.nativeContract: 18 passed on composition002, including real competing/crashed owners, failed drain retention, ordinary patched open refusal, stale source checks, and a real registered high-level before-switch hook whose non-entry is observed. Its first Linux execution failed 16 of 18 checks because acquired kernel-name locks have no filesystem sidecar; those raw failures are preserved.
validation.productionWorkerAndService: 9 passed across two suites, using real native files, OS leases, production worker entry, durable SQLite receipts and real process termination.
validation.directServiceSmoke: Exact original identity/history retained across cold and same-service reopen; duplicate receipt never opens; 3 owned workers reaped; 14 model-discovery fetch attempts blocked before transport.
validation.correctionMacOS: The new targeted already-open writer / replaced sidecar control failed against unchanged composition002 and passed with the two-file native correction. Both runs used real FileLock and SessionManager, with zero network attempts.
validation.correctionLinuxInstall: Physical deckbox Linux x64, Bun 1.3.14, process umask 0022: frozen install reproduced all 3129 corrected native package files byte-for-byte and mode-for-mode; bun.lock unchanged. A mermaid extraction failure and partial graph are preserved. Recovery used only a private mermaid cache whose 1171 files matched the published archive verified against the lock SHA512; no native package edits or chmod.
validation.correctionLinuxNative: 18 passed, 0 failed, 1 explicitly skipped filesystem-sidecar-only control. Real cross-process exclusion, release, crash recovery and failed terminal drain retention passed with no fabricated sidecar. The first corrected run's obsolete unconditional fixture assertion failed and is preserved; it was removed without changing production source.
validation.correctionLinuxWorkerAndService: 9 passed across the two existing production worker/service suites, 73 assertions. Disposable settings and credentials only; model-discovery fetches blocked before transport.

limits: No exclusion of unpatched stock/bundled writers, arbitrary direct filesystem or FileSessionStorage writers, non-file backends, in-memory replication or an outside actor deleting the marker.
Windows behavior is not established by these macOS/Linux runs. The Linux sidecar-replacement check is explicitly skipped because its pinned backend has no filesystem sidecar.
Plan save/approve-fresh and btw-promotion guards are source-verified at their owning pre-effect boundary; those provider-dependent scenarios were not executed.

Root owns discovery, public DTO/HTTP/UI, catalog reservation/publication and full-host integration acceptance. The service fixture controls only the catalog reservation port, not the native manager, worker or ownership mechanism.
